about: LH035 candidates without a row in instruments.json, each with its class and reason. A row is included when the pages read show data, link to data files, or describe the data as public, published, free or openly licensed. 'undetermined' = documentation read, but the pages read put the data behind an account, request, credentials or subscription without saying any is free, or say nothing of its availability, so the brief's inclusion rule could not be applied; 'unreadable' = the instrument's pages could not be read in this run (inconclusive, not excluded); 'excluded' = fails an inclusion rule, with the reason. Read on 2026-11-02.

rows.name: CAIDA AS Facilities
rows.origin: c (search L1b results 3 and 9; current catalogue page read)
rows.reason: Access "subject to the terms of the following CAIDA Acceptable Use Agreement" through a request form; whether it is free is not stated. The page also gives one measurement period, March to April 2017, last modified 24 June 2020, and "Not all facilities have all fields".

rows.name: USC/ISI ANT datasets (censuses, hitlists, outages, Trinocular)
rows.reason: "See our separate datasets requests page for steps to take to get access to our data"; terms and cost not stated on the page read. The page itself states censuses that "ping every allocated IP address one time over about two months", 2 censuses "every 2-4 months" since 2006, hitlists since 2009, and "We used to provide geolocation data but no longer can."

rows.name: ICANN Centralized Zone Data Service (CZDS)
rows.origin: c (ICANN's public data announcement, search L4b result 2, not opened; CZDS page read directly)
rows.reason: A sign-in page: zone files "provided by participating generic Top-Level Domains (gTLDs)", account required, cost not stated; for a TLD "not listed in CZDS" one must ask the registry.

rows.name: DNS Coffee
rows.reason: Data from "public zone files, DNS queries to public nameservers, and public domain lists" for "over 1200" zones since 2011; its API is "private, authenticated" and on request; whether the site's own pages may be read freely is implied by a ban on scraping but not stated. Limits it states: "Zone files are periodic snapshots, so a name that appears and disappears between two imports may not be recorded at all."

rows.name: Docker Hub
rows.reason: "Most Docker Hub API endpoints require you to authenticate using your Docker credentials"; responses vary by subscription; no page read says whether pull counts or tags are readable by others without payment. (Lighthouse's own studies read image tags through the registry; that is the repository's experience, not this page read.) The pull page defines "A Docker pull includes both a version check and any download" and counts a multi-architecture pull once per architecture. The subscription page says "Docker Personal and Docker Pro are subscriptions for individual accounts" without saying whether Personal is free.

rows.name: Hugging Face Hub download counts
rows.reason: The page defines a download ("Every HTTP request to these files, including GET and HEAD, will be counted as a download"; GGUF files counted so that cloning a repository "will double count") but does not say where counts are published or on what terms. The API page says "We have open endpoints that you can use to retrieve information from the Hub" and that "All API calls are subject to the HF-wide Rate limits", but does not say whether download counts are among that information.

rows.name: Shodan
rows.origin: c (named in search summaries L5a, L6b, L9b)
rows.reason: The help page describes "banners, which are metadata about a software that's running on a device" and an aim "to provide a complete picture of the Internet", but gives no access terms, and the pricing page returned HTTP 403.

rows.name: Netlas
rows.reason: A data collection policy (last updated 14 September 2026): "collects only externally accessible and publicly available data", "Only nonintrusive techniques"; access terms not stated.

rows.name: Software Heritage
rows.reason: Every page tried returned 503 or an Anubis bot-protection block.

rows.name: National Vulnerability Database (NVD)
rows.reason: Both pages returned only the title "NVD - Home" to the fetch tool, as in LH003.

rows.name: Internet Atlas (University of Wisconsin)
rows.origin: c (named in the summary of search L1a)
rows.reason: The host name did not resolve from this container; no other address for it was in the search results.

rows.name: RIPEstat
rows.origin: c (named in the summary of search L3b)
rows.reason: The documentation URL tried returned 404; no other page was tried within the ceiling.

rows.name: Rapid7 Project Sonar / Sonar data
rows.origin: c (search L6b result 10 variant; LH003 excluded it unread)
rows.reason: A commercial product with no public data: access "granted on a commercial basis to qualified organizations" since a policy change of 10 February 2022.

rows.name: ITSA, Internet Traffic Statistics Archive (University of Twente)
rows.reason: Only a 2016 publication record was read (weekly reports from NetFlow since 2013); it gives no address for the archive and nothing read shows the data are still kept available.

rows.name: Public IXP traffic compilation (472 exchanges, 2023 to 2024)
rows.origin: c (search L10b result 11, opened; the study is L10a result 5 and L10b result 1)
rows.reason: A one-off study (blog post of 9 April 2026 on a NINeS 2026 paper) of exchanges' own public graphs; the compiled data are not stated as kept available. Its stated limit, "Public IXP data does not include private interconnections", is recorded in the record's Findings. The exchanges' graphs themselves are each an exchange's view of its own estate.

rows.name: Cloudflare AI Crawl Control
rows.reason: An organisation's view of its own customers' zones, needing an account for the zone; its subject is AI crawlers (LH003's subject). Not re-read.

rows.name: OpenRouter rankings; Anthropic Economic Index; OpenAI usage paper; AI Incident Database
rows.reason: Their subject is AI activity and they observe none of the ten layers. Not re-read.

rows.name: Epoch AI's other datasets (models, chips, polling)
rows.reason: AI subject with no layer here; only its data-centre dataset has a row (I03).
